context: Final reflection on the AI-and-society unit
purpose: Teach: 人工/地下/地上/耐え/苦笑/辞典/ペット/ヒト

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: では、AIと社会の単元の最後に、皆さんの感想を聞かせてください。人工知能は本当に私たちの暮らしを良くしましたか？
lines.en: Well then, to close our unit on AI and society, let me hear your impressions. Has artificial intelligence really improved our lives?
lines.style: Polite teacher prompting a final reflective discussion

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 正直、便利すぎて怖いくらいです。地下鉄のホームでも、画面ばかり見ている人ばかりですし。
lines.en: Honestly, it's so convenient it's almost scary. Even on the subway platform, everyone just stares at their screens.
lines.style: University student speaking thoughtfully in polite form

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: うちなんてさ、紙の辞典なんて開いたこともないよ。全部AIに聞いちゃう。
lines.en: Like, I've never even opened a paper dictionary. I just ask the AI everything.
lines.style: Teen girl casual and self-deprecating tone

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ふふ、正直ですね。でも、地上波のニュースでも『ヒト型ロボットがペットの代わりになる』なんて話題が出ていますよ。
lines.en: Ha, very honest of you. But even on terrestrial TV news, they're discussing humanoid robots replacing pets.
lines.style: Teacher gently amused yet polite and concerned

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: ペットの代わりは、ちょっと耐えられないですね。生き物の温かさまでは再現できないと思います。
lines.en: Replacing pets is something I really couldn't bear. I don't think the warmth of a living being can be reproduced.
lines.style: University student earnest objection in polite speech

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: でもさ、ヒトのDNAまで解析できる時代でしょ？そのうち感情だって作れちゃうんじゃない？
lines.en: But you know, we live in an age where they can analyze even human DNA. Won't they eventually manufacture emotions too?
lines.style: Teen pushing back with casual provocative curiosity

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 鋭い指摘です。だからこそ、私たちが何を大切にするか問われているのでしょう。
lines.en: A sharp observation. That's precisely why we are being asked what we ourselves value most.
lines.style: Teacher affirming student with measured polite gravitas

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 便利さに流されないように、自分の頭で考え続けたいです。
lines.en: I want to keep thinking with my own head, so I don't get swept away by mere convenience.
lines.style: University student concluding with quiet resolve politely

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: あたしも、たまには辞典でも引いてみようかな。あはは、無理かも。
lines.en: Maybe I'll try cracking open a dictionary once in a while too. Haha, probably impossible though.
lines.style: Teen self-mocking light closing joke casual
